claim_text: Tomato is highly susceptible to Early Blight caused by Alternaria solani under high humidity conditions.
Copper Hydroxide Spray is an effective preventative bactericide and fungicide against Early Blight.
Bacillus subtilis provides effective biological phyllosphere suppression of Alternaria solani.
Neem Oil Extract is an effective standalone curative treatment for Early Blight on tomatoes under humid conditions.
Extended relative humidity (>80%) and temperatures 24-30C drastically accelerate Early Blight sporulation and foliar infection.
Streptomycin Sulfate cure rate for Tomato Yellow Leaf Curl Virus without vector containment.
Tomato thrives best in well-drained loamy sand or alluvial silt with optimal soil pH between 6.0 and 7.0.
